end.summary:
Discussed how trees support birds, hold soil, and help water enter the ground.
Named Bishnoi practices, Amrita Devi, and the protection of 363 trees.
Explained sacred groves as protected forest areas left undisturbed.
Connected neem leaves keeping insects away with a simple observation and noted that a fair test was not done.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Dev practised explaining how traditional practices protect nature and linking observations about neem leaves with science. They recalled Bishnoi, Amrita Devi, sacred groves, and several ways trees help nature. Dev was careful to say when they were guessing or had not tested an idea; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, an adult could help Dev compare two small areas—one with neem leaves and one without—and record what they observe safely.
